title: perfcheck names_successor still lets a dropped test excuse itself by its class, full id or bare parametrized name
goal: Found by the fresh-context review of SP-matmvkn6, item BG-5h2jpe3e (perfcheck names_successor accepts the retired-feature phrase beside the dropped test file itself): the skip set of names_removed holds only the dropped test function names and file basenames, so a reason naming the dropped test's class (TestAudit), its full id (_tools/test_audit.py::test_x) or the bare name of a parametrized id (test_x for test_x[a]) beside the live-module-calls-went-with phrase still counts as a successor. names_successor skips every form of the dropped ids' own names.

run: import sys,tempfile; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import perfcheck; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); r=perfcheck.names_successor('live-module calls went with `TestAudit`', ['_tools/test_audit.py::TestAudit::test_x'], d, ''); print(r); sys.exit(1 if r else 0)

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 9 of 13, "Test suite and tools docs fixes"); it blocks no fitness test and no real user reported it, so it sits in a late sprint of the sequence.
